#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long dfs(long long ones[], long long n, int idx) {
    long long quot = n / ones[idx];
    long long rem = n % ones[idx];
    long long used = quot * idx;
    if (rem == 0) return used;
    else return used + min(dfs(ones, rem, idx - 1),
                           idx + dfs(ones, ones[idx] - rem, idx - 1));
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    long long ones[17];
    ones[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
        ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1;
    }
    long long ans = dfs(ones, n, 16);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
